spells.name: Icebound Flames
spells.note: The only kick target in the fight (46 kicks vs 5 completions on Mythic PTR); wowhead lists the 12s DoT + 50% snare as dispel type Magic, but no healer is assigned to it — the answer is the kick.

spells.name: Frostfire Volley
spells.note: Cast marker for the missile barrage that applies the element debuffs and drops Fire/Frost patches.

spells.name: Burning Flames
spells.note: Fire element marker, 1 min, no dispel type — the failure is colliding with a Piercing Frost carrier, not carrying it.

spells.name: Piercing Frost
spells.note: Frost element marker, 1 min, carries a movement slow, no dispel type — opposite pole to Burning Flames.

spells.name: Elemental Explosion
spells.note: Frostfire detonation when opposing elements meet — rare but 4 killing blows off one damaged player.

spells.name: Fire Patch
spells.note: Persistent fire ground left by Frostfire Volley — any tick on a player means they stood in it.

spells.name: Frost Patch
spells.note: Persistent frost ground left by Frostfire Volley — any tick on a player means they stood in it.

spells.name: Spreading Flames
spells.note: Fire patch growth component — same rule as Fire Patch, 1 killing blow on Mythic PTR.

spells.name: Blink Nova
spells.note: Cast marker — Iku charges arcane power and blinks to a player.

spells.name: Blink Nova
spells.note: Arcane damage ID — wowhead shows a 300 yd radius with no distance falloff, so it is unavoidable raid damage; 6 killing blows means deaths only, never a positioning failure.

spells.name: Shredding Shards
spells.note: Primary tank channel — shards every 0.5s for 4s at the current target; damage on a non-tank is a positioning failure.

spells.name: Shredding Shards
spells.note: Secondary cast ID (encounter-journal canonical) — same rule as 1310616.

spells.name: Shredding Shards
spells.note: Stacking +50% damage taken from Shredding Shards — this is the ID that drives the Iku tank swap.

spells.name: Cataclysmic Invocation
spells.note: Escalating raid explosion when an ally explorer dies — journal-confirmed, never cast in the PTR sample.

spells.name: United Defense
spells.note: Heroic+ only: all three explorers take 99% reduced damage while within 30 yds of each other — a boss buff, invisible to player-event detection.

spells.name: Steady Strikes
spells.note: Debuff on Nama's current target, +4% damage taken from Nama per melee for 30s — his tank-swap driver.

spells.name: Shell Spin
spells.note: Cast marker — three spinning shells hurled in a frontal cone.

spells.name: Shell Spin
spells.note: 4s stun on shell contact, no dispel type — any application on any player is a dodge failure.

spells.name: Mighty Thud
spells.note: Leap cast marker — Nama marks three players and leaps at each.

spells.name: Mighty Thud
spells.note: Second leap cast ID — marker only.

spells.name: Mighty Thud
spells.note: Third leap cast ID — marker only.

spells.name: Mighty Thud
spells.note: Fourth leap cast ID — marker only.

spells.name: Mighty Thud
spells.note: Impact damage split among everyone in the landing zone — a soak, so deaths mean too few bodies in the marker.

spells.name: Aftershock
spells.note: Quaking ground left where Mighty Thud landed, 10 dps Heroic / 20 dps Mythic — any tick after the soak means the crater was not cleared.

spells.name: Relentless Escalation
spells.note: Self-buff on Nama when an ally explorer dies (wowhead: self-cast proc aura) — an out-of-sync-kill marker, not a player-facing event.

spells.name: Throw Junk
spells.note: Primary crate-toss cast marker (x238 Mythic) — spawns Useless Junk crates, not a failure.

spells.name: Throw Junk
spells.note: Encounter-journal canonical cast ID — marker only.

spells.name: Throw Junk
spells.note: Third crate-toss cast variant — marker only.

spells.name: Throw Junk
spells.note: Fourth crate-toss cast variant — marker only.

spells.name: Throw Junk
spells.note: Crate impact damage — being under a landing crate is a positioning failure, 5 killing blows on Mythic PTR.

spells.name: Splinters
spells.note: Stacking Physical bleed from clipping a crate, 8s, spreads on Mythic — wowhead lists NO dispel type, and the 17 log removals were all Cauterizing Flame, not a healer dispel.

spells.name: Mushroom Toss
spells.note: Spawns Bouncy Mushrooms — the tool used to dodge Blast Wave, never a threat.

spells.name: Mushroom Toss
spells.note: Second Mushroom Toss cast ID — marker only.

spells.name: Explosive Surprise
spells.note: 10s bomb-carrier marker, no dispel type — identifies who Gebbo threw the bomb at, never a failure by itself.

spells.name: Explosive Surprise
spells.note: Bomb impact — 10 yd Physical hit on everyone near the drop point.

spells.name: Concussive Blast
spells.note: 12s Fire DoT in a 10 yd radius left by the bomb detonation (wowhead: periodic damage, NOT a knockback) — any application means standing in the drop zone.

spells.name: Blast Wave
spells.note: The deadliest ID in the fight (18 killing blows Mythic, 39 Normal) — ground-level fire wave, avoided only by being airborne on a Bouncy Mushroom.

spells.name: Smashing Shovel
spells.note: Self-buff on Gebbo when an ally explorer dies (wowhead: proc-trigger aura on the caster) — an out-of-sync-kill marker, it never lands as a player damage event.

spells.name: Disgusting Fish
spells.note: SPELL ID NEEDED — the fish drops from broken crates and is fed to the controlled tortollan to stop Final Ascension; only its result (Fishy Feedback 1313303) is confirmed.

spells.name: Final Ascension
spells.note: The enrage channel — Shadow damage to the whole raid every 0.5s, broken only by feeding a Disgusting Fish, not by a kick.

spells.name: Final Ascension
spells.note: Second Final Ascension cast ID.

spells.name: Final Ascension
spells.note: Damage ID — 17 killing blows on Normal PTR, zero on Mythic; any death here is a fish-delivery failure, not an individual mistake.

spells.name: Dark Whispers
spells.note: Possession marker, instant cast so not kickable — the log attributes the source to the possessed explorer, not Mor'zahi.

spells.name: Mor'zahi's Command
spells.note: Marker that Mor'zahi retook control and granted the possessed explorer a new ability set.

spells.name: Mor'zahi's Command
spells.note: Second Command cast ID — marker only.

spells.name: Mor'zahi's Command
spells.note: Third Command cast ID — marker only.

spells.name: Malevolent Presence
spells.note: Unavoidable raid-wide Shadow tick every 2s all fight — never a failure, but 8 killing blows means it is what finishes players left low by other mistakes.

spells.name: Fishy Feedback
spells.note: Shadow burst + 12s raid DoT, no dispel type — the price of every successful fish, so plan healing cooldowns around it.

spells.name: Dark Unity
spells.note: Applies Share Damage 100% between the explorers — journal-confirmed, effect on cleave priority unconfirmed on live.

spells.name: Haunting Spirits
spells.note: Shadow DoT plus a silence, no dispel type — logged with source 'Environment', so caster and trigger are unconfirmed and it is surfaced informationally.

adds.name: Creepy Statue
adds.note: Static hazard statues around the chamber — never targeted, they exist purely to shrink the safe floor.

spells.name: Evil Eyes
spells.note: Cast marker and the most-cast ability in the fight (x700 Mythic) — the journal lists it under Mor'zahi but WCL attributes the cast to Creepy Statue.

spells.name: Evil Eyes
spells.note: Impact damage within 3 yds of each eye — any damage event means the player stood in one.

spells.name: Creepy Flames
spells.note: Ground-hazard spawn marker (wowhead: dummy aura + server-side script) — only casts appear in the logs, so its damage ID is unconfirmed and it cannot be scored as avoidable.

adds.name: Bouncy Mushroom
adds.note: Spawned by Mushroom Toss — a raid tool, not an enemy; bouncing off one launches you over Blast Wave, so do not kill them.

spells.name: Bounce
spells.note: Cast ID fired when a player contacts the mushroom.

spells.name: Bounce
spells.note: Airborne debuff — its presence during a Blast Wave window is the SUCCESS signal, never a failure.

spells.name: Fungal Burst
spells.note: SPELL ID NEEDED — Nature damage in 5 yds when a mushroom is triggered (warcraft.wiki.gg adventure guide), no matching ID in the PTR sample.

spells.name: Falling
spells.note: Generic environmental fall damage after a Bounce — too generic to score as avoidable, so surface it informationally and let the death report catch the 2 kills.

adds.name: Useless Junk
adds.note: Crate spawned by Throw Junk — walking into one applies Splinters, and it ruptures after ~25s if not destroyed, which is also how the Disgusting Fish drops.

spells.name: Relic Rupture
spells.note: Rupture cast marker — count against Throw Junk casts to get the crate-cleave rate.

spells.name: Relic Rupture
spells.note: Rupture damage to the raid — deaths here are a crate-cleave failure, not a positioning failure.

spells.name: Relic Rupture
spells.note: Second rupture damage ID — 20 players hit and 6 killing blows on Mythic PTR, same raid-level attribution.

adds.name: Useless Junk
adds.note: Second crate NPC ID seen in the same encounter — identical Relic Rupture behaviour, so both IDs must be counted.
